title: THE GOLDEN LABEL STANDS ABOVE THE NAMEPLATE
why: Every body in sight wears its nameplate over its head, and the golden enemy has a GOLDEN label over its head too. The label was set at a fixed height that is where the nameplate sits, so whenever the golden enemy was in sight GOLDEN was printed across the top of its name. Proven in headless Chromium on real frames, every raid has one: at 1080p GOLDEN overlapped the CRAWLER nameplate by 43 by 10 pixels (sentry 43 by 12, howler 43 by 13), at 4K by 86 by 19. The label now stands just above the plate, at its old height or higher. Its words, colour and size are unchanged.
now: The GOLDEN label over the golden enemy no longer prints on top of its name.
